title: Popcorn
review: Such a chaotic script! Characters come and go in a way that makes them hard to remember, random movie and musical scenes break up the story like a variety show, and the whole thing seems like they came up with a bunch of cool scene ideas before tying them together with a story. It was fun, but I have already forgotten most of the details as I write this review a couple of weeks later. I just remember being mildly entertained, and enjoying the films within the film the most.
